fusions.name: Snag and Hold
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range. It stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Return
fusions.desc: Casts a hooked link at the first enemy it meets that deals 9 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Tangle Back
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Line Taken In
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, you regain 3 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
